newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks off peaks but still solidly higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks off peaks but still solidly higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks retreated from their session highs as a rally in U.S. Treasuries lost steam in late afternoon trading.

The Dow industrials rose 60 points to 5667, and the Nasdaq Composite gained 14 to 1139. The benchmark 30-year bond gained 12/32 to yield 7.12 percent. Earlier, bonds had risen by as much as three-quarters of a point.
"Bonds are still stuck in a tight trading range, and I still think stocks are following bonds," said Philip Orlando, chief investment officer at Value Line Asset Management.
